changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment: FINERACT-2797: persist whether a savings account transaction was created through the "Force Withdrawal" command (FINERACT-2471), so future balance re-validations can recognize a historical negative-balance excursion as legitimately authorized, instead of relying solely on the caller context of a later, unrelated transaction.

changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment: Backfill is_force_transaction=true for pre-existing force-withdrawal transactions, identified via the audit trail (m_portfolio_command_source) since the flag did not exist at the time those transactions were originally created.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_savings_account_transaction t SET is_force_transaction = true FROM m_savings_account_transaction msat INNER JOIN m_portfolio_command_source c ON c.resource_id = msat.id WHERE t.id = msat.id AND c.action_name = 'FORCE_WITHDRAWAL' AND c.entity_name = 'SAVINGSACCOUNT' AND c.resource_id IS NOT NULL AND msat.is_force_transaction = false;

rollback.sql: UPDATE m_savings_account_transaction t SET t.is_force_transaction = false FROM m_savings_account_transaction msat INNER JOIN m_portfolio_command_source c ON c.resource_id = msat.id WHERE t.id = msat.id AND c.action_name = 'FORCE_WITHDRAWAL' AND c.entity_name = 'SAVINGSACCOUNT';
